title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E6 — When You Comin' Back, Range Rider?
The team attacks a trainload of mustangs headed for Mexico, only to have Hannibal and B.A. taken prisoner.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E7 — The Taxicab Wars
Hannibal poses as a rich Texan and his cohorts work as cabbies to save a struggling company from a ruthless competitor (Michael Ironside).

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E8 — Labor Pains
The team defends striking farmworkers from a corrupt grower paying starvation wages; guest Penny Peyser.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E9 — There's Always a Catch
An extortionist threatens a fisherman's livelihood. With George Peppard, Dirk Benedict, Mr. T, Dwight Schultz.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E10 — Water, Water Everywhere
A greedy developer attempts to stop disabled veterans (Jim Knaub, Jon L. Feather, R. David Smith) from renovating a desert town.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S3 E22 — Nine Hours
Hit men kidnap a child to force Banner to cooperate in their killing of a hospitalized mob witness.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S3 E23 — On the Line
Firefighters suspect Banner of starting a forest blaze; guest Kathleen Lloyd.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S4 E1 — Prometheus
Trapped halfway through his transformation by meteor radiation, Banner and a blinded girl are taken to a research facility.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S4 E2 — Prometheus
The Hulk must escape from the research facility's underground labyrinth; guest Monte Markham.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S4 E10 — Wax Museum
Banner helps a young woman whose father left her a wax museum, now run by her unscrupulous uncle.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S3 E9 — Dead of Knight
A dancer dies from poison gas meant for Michael, who searches desperately for its source.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S3 E10 — Lost Knight
A boy (Jason Bateman) adopts KITT after a collision leaves Michael dazed and the supercar without its memory.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E6 — Brushfire
A canyon fire threatens the residents of a housing development and keeps the paramedics on round-the-clock duty; guest Tony Dow.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E7 — Dealer's Wild
DeSoto and Gage talk down an airplane flown by a teenage boy whose father, the pilot, suffered a heart attack while at the controls.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E8 — Nurses Wild
The paramedics hold a demonstration for student nurses, one of whom interests Gage; the hospital staff saves a robber and his victim.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E9 — Publicity Hound
Gage resents media attention given to a paramedic (Gary Crosby) from another squad; Brackett clashes with a tycoon over a diagnosis.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E10 — Weird Wednesday
The paramedics and hospital staff deal with a stubborn elderly woman (Jeanette Nolan), a parachutist in a tree and other odd cases.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E11 — Dilemma
Gage and DeSoto rescue an elderly couple from an elevator crash; Brackett berates a forgetful student nurse; a girl irritates Gage.
